title: Retrace: dodge your own past · arcade game for iPhone and iPad
meta_description: Fly a paper plane to the gate, then do it again with every flight you've already made in the way. A one-thumb arcade game for iPhone and iPad. Free, and it plays offline.
og_description: Every flight you finish comes back in the next round. How far can you get?
jsonld_description: A one-thumb arcade game where every flight you finish comes back in the next round, and touching one ends your run.
hero_title: Every flight you finish comes back to race you.
hero_body: Hold to take off, slide to steer, reach the gate at the top. Make it, and that exact flight joins the next round. By round ten the sky is full of you. Don't touch a single one.
store_label: Download Retrace on the App Store
meta_soon: Coming soon, free on iPhone and iPad
how_1_body: Hold anywhere to take off and slide your thumb to turn. Your plane never stops, so pick your line early.
how_2_body: Fly through the gate at the top to clear the round. Then you're back at the start, and so is everything you just did.
how_3_body: Every flight you finish replays in the next round, all at once and a little faster. Touch one and the run is over. The glowing band at the start is the only place they can't get you.
rival_heading: No levels. No story. Just you against you.
rival_body: Your score is the round you reach. Every round is built from your own moves, so the game is exactly as hard as you made it. Get caught, share your card and see if a friend can get further.
powers_heading: A little help, now and then
powers_intro: Tokens drop into some rounds. Grab one, clear the round, and it waits in the corner until you need it.
pu_grace_body: The safe band at the start doubles in height for a round.
pu_start_body: Slide your plane along the line and take off from wherever you like.
pu_speed_body: Fly faster than all your past flights for one round.
pu_immunity_body: One round where nothing can catch you.
pu_erase_body: One of your past flights is gone for the rest of the run.
extras: Between runs there are missions to finish, gems to earn and new planes to unlock in the hangar.
last_body: It's free, and your best is waiting to be beaten.
support_description: Get help with Retrace and answers to common questions
support_intro: Something not working, or just a question? Write to us and we'll get back to you.
support_details: It helps if you tell us which iPhone or iPad you're on and the version number shown at the bottom of the game's settings.
support_a_death: Your plane touched one of your past flights. Only the planes themselves can catch you, never the dotted lines behind them. The glowing band at the start is safe: nothing can catch you while you're in it, and a past flight inside it can't catch anyone either.
support_a_powerups: Every few rounds a token appears in the sky. Touch it and clear that round, and its power-up lands in the corner. Tap the corner before you take off to use it on the round ahead. You hold one at a time, and a new one replaces the old. If the corner is empty you can also get one by watching a short ad or paying with gems. There are five: Big safe zone, Pick start, Flash, Immunity and Erase a past.
support_q_gems: How do I get gems, and what are they for?
support_a_gems: You earn gems by going deep in a run (every ten rounds) and by beating your best, from missions, from one free-gems ad a day in the shop, or with a gem pack. Spend them on planes in the hangar, a power-up in the corner or a revive when you get caught. Gems live on your device only, so deleting the game resets them.
support_q_ads: Can I get rid of the ads?
support_a_ads: Yes. No Ads, in the shop or in settings, removes the banner and the ads between runs for good. The video you can choose to watch for a revive, a power-up or free gems stays, since it's only ever played when you tap it.
support_q_restore: I bought No Ads and the ads are back
support_a_restore: Open settings or the shop and tap Restore purchases, signed in with the same Apple Account you bought it with. Gem packs can't be restored: they're used up once they land.
support_q_reminders: How do I turn reminders off?
support_a_reminders: Open settings from the gear on the home screen and turn off reminders, or switch off notifications for Retrace in iOS Settings. The game sends one at most a day, at 7 pm, only on a day you haven't played, and stops after a week without playing.
support_a_languages: Retrace plays in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, traditional and simplified Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Vietnamese, Turkish and Russian. It follows your device's language, and uses English for any other.
privacy_description: What Retrace collects, why, and how to change your choices
privacy_short: The short version: there's no account and we never ask who you are. The game sends play data under a random id, not your name, so we can make it better, and it shows ads through Google AdMob, with your choice about personalised ads asked first. Everything else stays on your device.
privacy_local: Your best round, your gems, the planes you've unlocked, your missions and your settings. None of it is sent to us, and deleting the game deletes it. We never ask for your name, email, contacts, photos or location.
privacy_analytics_html: The game sends gameplay events to GameAnalytics: when a run starts and ends and the round it reached, power-ups taken and used, missions finished, gems earned and spent, purchases, ads shown, and which screens you open. They're sent under a random id made on your device the first time you play, which isn't linked to your name or your Apple Account. GameAnalytics also records your device model, iOS version, connection type and the identifier for vendor, works out your country from your IP address, and reads your device's advertising identifier only if you allow tracking.
privacy_analytics_why: We use this to see where players get stuck and how the game is balanced. We don't sell it.
privacy_ads_intro: Ads are served by Google AdMob, in three places:
privacy_ads_list_html:
• a banner at the bottom of the home screen and the menus, never while you're flying;
  • now and then, a full-screen ad between two runs, never in your first two runs and never more than once a minute of play;
  • a short video when you tap to watch one, for a revive, a power-up or free gems.
privacy_ads_data_html: To show ads, Google receives your IP address, device and app details, and the advertising identifier if you allow tracking. In the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland you're asked for consent first, and iOS asks separately whether apps may track you. If you say no to either, you still get the whole game, with ads that aren't personalised; Google may still use some data to limit how often you see an ad, measure ads and prevent fraud. Google's use of this data is described in How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services.
privacy_ads_choice: You can change your answer at any time from Ads & privacy in the game's settings, or under Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking on your device. No Ads, bought once, removes the banner and the ads between runs.
privacy_purchases: No Ads and the gem packs are bought through Apple. Apple handles the payment and we never see your card or your Apple Account details, only that a purchase went through.
privacy_gamecenter_html: Ranks uses Apple's Game Center. The game only asks you to sign in when you open Ranks. Once you're signed in, your best round is posted to the leaderboard under your Game Center name, where other players can see it. Apple handles this under its privacy policy.
privacy_sharing: Your share card is made on your device and only goes where you send it through the iOS share sheet. Saving it to Photos asks for permission to add pictures, never to read them.
privacy_notifications: If you turn reminders on, they're scheduled on your device. Nothing about them is sent to a server.
privacy_children: Retrace is rated 4+ on the App Store and is made for a general audience, so players of every age are welcome. Ads in the game are limited to content suitable for all ages. We don't ask anyone's age and don't knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you think a child has sent us personal information, write to us and we'll delete it.
privacy_delete: Deleting the game removes everything stored on your device and its random id; play again and you start with a new one. Because that id isn't tied to who you are, we can't look your analytics up by name or email. If you'd still like something removed or have a question about it, write to us.
privacy_changes: If what the game collects changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top.
